listTool.description: List all available agents. Before performing any new task, first use the list_agent tool to get a list of all available agents. Then, use the get_agent tool to get the content for the specific agent most closely related to the task, if any. If no agent is closely related to the task, then continue without using the get_agent tool. If you have already gotten the content for an agent and the next task is closely related to that same agent, then you can rely on the instructions you have already gotten without needing to use the get_agent tool again.
